title: Moroccan Gouda Tagine
description: A creamy, comforting dish inspired by traditional Moroccan cuisine, featuring a rich and flavorful tagine sauce with gouda cheese.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Moroccan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the silky tagine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the nourishing vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the shredded gouda cheese until melted and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a filling meal.
